top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology and its active form is a complete, independently confirmed arc from hormone biology to drugs with large randomised outcome evidence in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease. Drucker, Holst and Mojsov fit the three-name limit under a physiology-anchored citation. The Knudsen gap and Mojsov's contested priority are real but no documented ground displaces anyone, so awarding is clearly preferable to no award.
